fightSong.title: Bull Market
fightSong.lyrics: Buy low, sell high, watch us climb / Denver money, every time / Wall Street West, we own the street / Can't beat the market, can't beat the heat!

stadium.name: The Exchange
stadium.tradition: The Opening Bell — a real NYSE bell is rung pre-game by a local CEO. If the market was up Friday, we wear alternate jerseys.

fanCulture.description: They wear Patagonia vests over jerseys. After sacks they yell 'SHORT SELL!' They track cap space like fantasy points.
fanCulture.tailgate: Craft IPAs and charcuterie boards at altitude.

rivalries.name: The Cookout
rivalries.narrative: Sauce vs suit. They smoke meat, we smoke portfolios.

cityFlavor: Mile high, high finance. We ski, we invest, we win.
